### Exercise 14.2: Construct a perpendicular line from a point away from the line

4. Draw line $ST$ as shown below. Point $P$ is a point away from the line.

Source image: https://electricbookworks.github.io/siyavula-open-textbooks-images/items/images/web/ebw-jss1-14-034.png

Construct $PQ$ perpendicular to line $ST$.
assessment.expected_answer:
Follow the Steps as shown in Worked example 14.2.

Solution image: https://electricbookworks.github.io/siyavula-open-textbooks-images/items/images/web/ebw-jss1-14-035.png

If you have worked accurately, the two lines will intersect each other at an angle of $90^{\circ}$.
